Coupled-mode dashboard, carbon/atmos benchmarks, model summary (#67) (#67)

Benchmarks
- Inversion-derived carbon benchmarks: nee (CarbonTracker CT2022),
  gpp (GOSIF-GPP v2), er (residual), hr (Hashimoto 2015), via the
  inversion_nee artifact; carbon fluxes displayed in g C m^-2 day^-1.
- ERA5 surface-flux benchmarks under both the ClimaLand names
  (lhf, shf, lwu, swu) and the ClimaAtmos/CMIP names (hfls, hfss, rlus, rsus).
- Observation product names (ERA5, GOSIF, ...) shown in the time-series
  legend, bias title/colorbar and metrics rows.

Dashboard features
- dashboard(path; coupled = true) for ClimaCoupler outputs: Component menu
  (atmos/land/ocean/seaice), atmos restricted to monthly _1M_ native-grid
  diagnostics, missing land start_date inherits the atmos one, per-component
  benchmark caches.
- "Model summary" button: overlay with global RMSE (and bias) of every
  benchmarked variable over the full simulation period, per season,
  color-coded by RMSE relative to the observed mean; persisted in the cache.
- Time-series mode menu: Local (click map) or Global. Global statistics
  (time series, metrics, summary) follow the component's spatial mask:
  ocean-masked land mean for land runs, full globe for atmos, land-masked
  ocean mean for ocean/seaice.
- run_title kwarg: optional caption in the menu.

Responsiveness
- Benchmark session caches keyed (variable, reduction, period, level) and
  retained across variable switches - revisiting a variable is instant.
- Map colorbar limits (full-field quantile scan) cached per
  (variable, reduction, period, level, height).
- Time-slider scrubbing no longer blocks ~2 s per tick on a cache miss:
  per-frame metrics run async with latest-wins, results cached.
- precompute = true also warms the model-summary cache.

Docs: new "Dashboard" page (usage, menus, benchmarks, coupled mode,
caching); obs registries added to the API reference.
Tests: test/test_coupler.jl (component discovery, 1M pruning, mask specs,
summary formatting); suite at 82 tests.
